lines: It's so white, it's so long.
The answer is probably just superficial common sense.
Even if my fingertips tremble.
Now, at a three-way intersection that shouldn't be on the map,
I find myself stuck.
What should I rely on to move forward?
It's true what they say about following the textbook.
It's full of difficult words.
Today, I haven't changed at all from back then.
If I fill in this blank, will it be solved someday?
How would you move forward?
It's so white, it's so long.
The answer is probably just superficial common sense.
Even if my fingertips tremble.
There is no right answer, there is no defeat.
I will be myself my whole life, and that is all.
Even if I stir things up further, there will be no tomorrow.
Now, blaming this useless map,
I am at a loss.
Even if I act tough, the outcome will probably be the same.
With a box so full it seems about to overflow,
I glance sideways at others'.
I still can't even manage a clumsy, ingratiating smile.
If only there weren't such a blank space, you would think so too.
To say 'this is fine as it is' — that alone is wrong.
It's empty, there's nothing at all.
I don't know if it disappeared or if it began.
There's no other way but to go, is there?
What is a right answer? It has no value.
I cannot live as anyone but myself my whole life.
Even if I stir things up further, there will be no tomorrow. Ah.
No matter how I struggle, there will be no tomorrow.
